pages.text: Hold three sized yarn and right-click a loom. Click when the thread lines up with the needle's eye. Three stitches make two $(item)Cloth Panels$() of the yarn's ★. A missed stitch can snap the thread.
pages.title: Weaving

pages.text: Cloth panels make staff wraps, and RPG robes and cloth armor.
Three sized yarn make a bowstring.
